name: Barstow Community College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take college classes for free while you are in high school. You could earn high school and college credit at the same time.
who_can_apply: You must be in grades 9 to 12. Home school students have their own steps. Middle or elementary school students can appeal to attend, and the program director decides.
pay_detail: Free up to the unit limit. If you go over the limit, you pay for all your units that semester. The page does not list other fees.
duration: By semester. Up to 11.5 units in fall or spring. Up to 6 units in summer.
deadline_text: No term dates are posted on the program page as of Nov 2, 2026. Ask the program about the next term.
how_to_apply: Apply on OpenCCC with a personal email and pick the K-12 concurrent enrollment major. Meet with a college counselor. Fill out the Dual Enrollment Agreement Form with all signatures. Do the online orientation. Then register for classes.
notes: You need a new form each semester. No PE or remedial classes. You must drop your own classes. If you have a 504 or IEP plan, apply to the ACCESS program for help. Questions: dual@barstow.edu.
